usage: 埋單 (maai4 daan1) is used when you want to ask for the bill at a restaurant or cafe.
You can use 埋單 as a noun, meaning 'the bill' itself, or as a phrase meaning 'to pay the bill.'
It is commonly used when signaling to a waiter that you are ready to pay.
The phrase is typically said at the end of a meal or when you decide to leave.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4, giu3 maai4 daan1.
examples.meaning: We finished eating, so we asked for the bill.

examples.jyutping: fuk6 mou6 jyun4, maai4 daan1, faai3 di1!
ngo5 gam1 ci3 fu6 zaak3 maai4 daan1.
examples.meaning: I will pay the bill this time.
